formulas.ascii: distances[source] = 0 and +Infinity elsewhere. Each round first copies distances to previousDistances, then every vertex u with finite previousDistances[u] offers previousDistances[u] + edgeWeights[slot] to each neighbor through an atomic float-ordered min on distances. Predecessors are reset where a round improved a vertex and set to the lowest u whose offer equals the new distance. Missing edge weights cost 1.0. A converged flag stops later rounds; there is no CPU priority queue.
